snippet.title: Sinever: First Seal | Official Trailer (1–4 Player Co-op Horror)
snippet.description:
Enter the estate with up to three friends. Every seal you disturb makes what waits inside stronger.

Sinever: First Seal is a psychological horror game you can play solo or in online co-op. Search an abandoned Victorian estate, use paranormal equipment and security cameras, and manage your sanity as you uncover its secret.

Wishlist Sinever: First Seal on Steam.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5001350/Sinever_First_Seal/

Release date: Coming soon
Developed by MAS Studios
